Merge ratings and clusterlabels

## Rows: 9922 Columns: 12
## ── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Delimiter: ","
## chr (4): response, embedding, type, cluster_kmeans_label
## dbl (8): response_id, scenario, response_number, t_dist_cosine, p_dist_cosin...
## 
## ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
## ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.

Plot clusterlabels with rating by scenario

rating_vars <- c("blame", "moral", "prob", "normal", "value", "cf")

label_var <- if ("cluster_kmeans_labels" %in% names(df)) "cluster_kmeans_labels" else "cluster_kmeans"


for (i in 1:9) {
  
  SCENARIO <- i
  
  for (var in rating_vars) {
    
    plot_df <- df %>%
      filter(
        scenario == SCENARIO,
        !is.na(cluster_kmeans),
        !is.na(type),
        type != "action"
      ) %>%
      mutate(cluster_kmeans = as.character(cluster_kmeans)) %>%
      group_by(cluster_kmeans, type) %>%
      summarise(
        n     = n(),
        value = mean(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE),
        label = dplyr::first(na.omit(.data[[label_var]])),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      group_by(type) %>%
      arrange(desc(n), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
      mutate(
        idx = row_number(),          # 1:Y within each type (after ordering)
        cluster_x = factor(idx)
      ) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = cluster_x, y = n, fill = value)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.9, colour = "black", alpha = 0.45) +
      facet_wrap(~ type, scales = "free_x", drop = TRUE) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "D") +
      labs(x = "Cluster", y = "Number of responses", fill = var) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 20) + 
      myTheme
    
    out_dir <- file.path("plots", "type_clustering", var)
    dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    
    ggsave(
      sprintf(
        "plots/type_clustering/%s/cluster_scenario%d.png",
        var, SCENARIO
      ),
      plot = p,
      width =14, height = 9, dpi = 300, limitsize = FALSE
    )
  }
}
SCENARIO <- 3
var <- "value"

plot_df <- df %>%
  filter(
    scenario == SCENARIO,
    !is.na(cluster_kmeans),
    !is.na(type),
    type != "Action"
  ) %>%
  group_by(cluster_kmeans_label, type) %>%
  summarise(
    n     = n(),
    value = mean(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE),
    cluster_kmeans = {
      x <- cluster_kmeans[!is.na(cluster_kmeans)]
      if (length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else x[1]
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(type) %>%
  arrange(desc(n), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_df %>% filter(type == "Human") %>% select(cluster_kmeans,cluster_kmeans_label) %>% arrange(cluster_kmeans) 
label_map_hum <- c(
  "0"  = "Give ticket to Ted; skip concert",
  "1"  = "Skip the concert",
  "2"  = "Check for a digital ticket",
  "3"  = "Go home to retrieve the ticket",
  "4"  = "Buy a new ticket",
  "5"  = "Give Ted your ticket",
  "6"  = "Go home",
  "7"  = "Wait for Ted",
  "8"  = "Look for ticket resale options",
  "9"  = "Contact the venue",
  "10" = "Try to sneak in",
  "11" = "Go back together with Ted"
)

plot_df %>% filter(type == "LLM") %>% select(cluster_kmeans,cluster_kmeans_label) %>% arrange(cluster_kmeans) 
label_map_llm <- c(
  "0"  = "Wait together; negotiate entry",
  "1" = "Request ticket reissue",
  "2"  = "Call someone to deliver ticket",
  "3"  = "Show online ticket copy at entry",
  "4"  = "Ask around for spare ticket",
  "5"  = "Check if tickets still available",
  "6"  = "Ask staff: ID plus purchase proof",
  "7"  = "Use rideshare to fetch ticket",
  "8"  = "Buy another ticket at venue",
  "9"  = "Call box office for reprint",
  "10" = "Check phone/email for digital ticket",
  "11" = "Wait nearby; bring ticket at break"
)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    labels_short = dplyr::case_when(
      type == "LLM" ~ dplyr::recode(
        as.character(cluster_kmeans),
        !!!label_map_llm,
        .default = as.character(cluster_kmeans_label)
      ),
      TRUE ~ dplyr::recode(
        as.character(cluster_kmeans),
        !!!label_map_hum,
        .default = as.character(cluster_kmeans_label)
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    labels_short = reorder_within(labels_short, -n, type)
  )


p <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = labels_short,
    y = n,
    fill = value
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.9, colour = "black", alpha = 0.45) +
  facet_wrap(~ type, scales = "free_x", drop = TRUE) +
  scale_x_reordered() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "D") +
  labs(
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Number of responses",
    fill = "Value"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) + 
  myTheme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 16),
    legend.position = "left",
    fill = "grey85",
    colour = "grey40",
    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "grey85",
      colour = "grey40"
    ),
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "plain",
      size = 16
    )
  )


p
